question: Repair the old laptop or replace it?
options: Repair: a new battery and a bigger drive
verdict: Repair it now, put the replacement money aside, and set a date to look again.
first_step: Book the repair shop's free check this week and get the quote in writing.

seats.line: A seven-year-old laptop will fail somewhere else next. You may pay twice.
The real need is email, photos and the school portal. Any working laptop does that.
Replace, and turn the old one into the family photo backup.
If the only problems are the battery and the space, fix those two things.
A quote takes a day. Shopping for a new one takes weeks of tabs.

outcome: Repairing it. The shop quoted a third of the price of a refurbished one. Looking again in March.
